overview: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) is a flagship scheme launched by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas in May 2016 to provide deposit-free LPG connections to women from poor households. The scheme aims to replace traditional cooking fuels with clean cooking fuel (LPG) to improve health and reduce environmental degradation. As of July 2026, over 10.56 crore LPG connections have been released under the scheme, including extensions like Ujjwala 2.0 and additional allocations. The scheme provides financial assistance for security deposit, regulator, hose, installation charges, and includes free first refill and stove.
target_beneficiaries: People residing in Islands and River Islands
objectives: Provide deposit-free LPG connections to women from poor households
Replace traditional cooking fuels (firewood, coal, cow-dung) with clean LPG
Improve health of rural women by reducing indoor air pollution
Reduce environmental degradation caused by traditional fuels
Empower women by providing clean cooking fuel access
Achieve universal access to LPG in India
Support migrant households through simplified documentation in Ujjwala 2.0
eligibility: The applicant must be a woman who has attained 18 years of age. There should be no other LPG connection from any Oil Marketing Company (OMC) within the same household. The adult woman must belong to a poor household based on submission of a deprivation declaration (as per prescribed format). Eligible categories include SC Households, ST Households, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin), Most Backward Classes, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Tea and Ex-Tea Garden tribes, Forest Dwellers, People residing in Islands and River Islands, SECC Households (AHL TIN), and Poor Household as per 14-point declaration.
benefits: Cash assistance for PMUY connections is provided by Government of India - Rs. 1600 (for a connection 14.2kg cylinder/ Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder). The cash assistance covers: Security Deposit of Cylinder – Rs. 1250 for 14.2 kg cylinder/ Rs. 800 for 5 kg cylinder, Pressure Regulator – Rs. 150, LPG Hose – Rs. 100, Domestic Gas Consumer Card – Rs. 25, Inspection/Installation/Demonstration charges – Rs. 75. Additionally, all PMUY beneficiaries are provided with first LPG refill and stove (hotplate) both free of cost along with their deposit-free connection by the Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs).

application_process: 1. Applicants can apply online through the application form available at https://pmuy.gov.in or visit the nearest CSC Centre for assistance in submitting the application. 2. There is no fee for self-submission. However, a charge of ₹20 will be applicable if the application is submitted through CSC Centres. 3. Offline applicants can directly submit the application at preferably nearest LPG distributorship of OMCs. 4. Required documents include KYC form, Aadhaar copy, proof of address, ration card or state government document certifying family composition, bank account details, and deprivation declaration. 5. For migrant applicants, self-declaration as per Annexure I for PoA and family composition is sufficient. 6. After submission, the application is verified by the LPG distributor and connection is released upon successful verification.

Proof of Address (only in case Address in Aadhaar is different from currently residing address) (Self Declaration as per Annexure I for migrant applicants)
Ration Card issued by the State from which application is being made / other State Govt. document certifying family composition ((Self Declaration as per Annexure I for migrant applicants)
Aadhaar copy of Applicant and adult family members appearing in document at Sl. 4
Mandate For Giving up LPG Subsidy
Grievance Redressal Form for PAHAL (DBTL) Scheme

deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG)
caveats: Households having Piped Natural Gas connection are not entitled for subsidized LPG
LPG connection cannot be provided to a person under 18 years of age
Beneficiary must not position any other LPG gas installations in the same kitchen
Biometric Aadhaar authentication (eKYC) is mandatory for connections enrolled under the PMUY scheme
Pre-Installation inspection is mandatory prior to release of a PMUY connection
If Aadhaar is not seeded or mapped correctly in NPCI mapper, subsidy may not be received
PMUY cylinder and stove are subsidized assets and cannot be sold or transferred to anyone else
